input.rationale: Blitzcrank is overperforming, especially in KR (53.1% WR, 27.7% ban rate). His power comes from how often he can threaten a hook, both in lane and in later fights. Raising Rocket Grab's cooldown by 1 second at every rank (20-16 → 21-17) gives opponents a slightly longer window after each missed or landed hook. That lowers his lane pressure and how often he can pick people off, while leaving his damage and the feel of his kit the same. Sim: soloq_index -1.63%, pro_index -0.63%. Both are inside their target bands with room to spare.

input.rationale: Malphite is winning too much in solo queue (53.4% WR globally and in KR, 16-18% ban rate) but barely shows up in pro play (2% presence). Players mostly complain about his early lane damage. Seismic Shard is the poke he uses to win lane early, so we're lowering its damage at ranks 1-3 (70/120/170 -> 60/105/150). Ranks 4-5, the ratios and his ultimate engage stay the same, so his late-game teamfight job doesn't change. In the sim, solo queue power drops by about 1.8%, near the middle of the target band. Pro power stays the same or goes up slightly (+0.8%). Lane trades at level 6 go from 335 to 321.

input.rationale: Kog'Maw is winning 54.5% in global solo queue with very low pro presence (3%). His solo queue power comes from bullying the lane early, not from his late-game scaling, which pro teams build around. We're cutting Caustic Spittle's (Q) damage at early ranks (80/125/170 -> 65/110/160) and leaving ranks 4-5 unchanged. This makes his early trades weaker (L6 lane trade 281 -> 270) and leaves his late-game DPS, siege power and utility as they are. Sim: soloq_index -0.94% (target -3% to -0.5%), pro_index +0.46% (target >= -0.5%). We chose this over a base AD nerf because base AD also cuts his late DPS and siege, which pro play relies on.

input.rationale: Ezreal is a pro-play staple (47% presence) while underperforming in solo queue (47.9% global / 48.4% KR WR). His pro value comes from late-game, coordinated siege and poke, with Trueshot Barrage as a global siege/teamfight tool at the center of it. We're reducing R base damage at ranks 2 and 3 (550/750 -> 500/650) while leaving rank 1 untouched. This trims his late siege and teamfight contribution (sim: pro_index -1.9%, late DPS and siege score down ~2%) without touching his laning or early/mid power (soloq_index unchanged), so solo queue players don't get hit on a champion who's already below 50%.

input.rationale: Qiyana is in pro jail: 57% pro presence while she sits below 49% win rate in solo queue (47.7% global, 48.2% KR). Her coordinated late-game burst is what keeps her picked in pro, so we're trimming her end-of-game damage and leaving her early game alone. Q (Edge of Ixtal) damage at ranks 4/5 goes from 160/190 to 150/165, and R (Supreme Display of Talent) bonus AD ratio goes from 1.25 to 1.10. Q ranks 1-3, all base stats, W and E are unchanged, so her lane and early skirmish power stay the same for solo queue players. In simulation, pro power drops by about 1.2% and solo queue power doesn't change. Lane trades and the level 9 duel are untouched; only late DPS and siege damage go down slightly.

input.rationale: Jayce is popular but losing in global solo queue (49.3% WR at 5.9% PR), while pro presence is already high (41%), so we want to help his laning without adding late-game or coordinated power. We're buffing Hammer Q (To the Skies) base damage at early ranks (60/110/160/210/260 → 72/125/175/222/266). Max rank stays at 310. This makes his early trades and all-ins stronger, but by full build he does almost exactly the same damage, so pro play gains nothing. Sim: soloq_index +0.95% (target +0.5% to +3%), pro_index -0.05% (target ≤ +1%). The single 'too strong' complaint goes against the data and the diagnosis, so we didn't act on it.
